Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Counter affidavit filed by Sri S.A. Khan on behalf of informant today is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the private respondent, learned AGA who appears on behalf of State-respondents and perused the record.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of the impugned First Information Report dated 30.9.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 0132 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354, 377 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Lucknow and for a direction to the opposite parties not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to the impugned FIR.

sentences.text: 1 This Court has earlier granted time to the learned AGA to seek instructions in the matter.

Learned AGA has produced before this Court a copy of the written instructions dated 12.5.2023 sent by Sub Inspector, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Lucknow wherein it has come out that the name of the petitioner no. 1, Dharmendra Saini has surfaced in the statement of informant recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. before the Magistrate concerned and Section 377 IPC has also been added thereafter against the petitioner no. 1.
. 1 has been absconding and trial court has also issued non bailable warrant against him on 10.5.2023 whereas charge sheet dated 5.5.2023
has been submitted to the supervisory authority against the other accused.

After having examined the facts and circumstances of the case and perused the impugned FIR, we are of the opinion that the impugned FIR discloses cognizable offence against the petitioners, hence,
no interference is called for by this Court in its extraordinary power under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of the FIR or for grant of any interim relief to the petitioners and accordingly, the present writ petition is dismissed.
